kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستسئل (form X)
# نَسْتَسْئِلُ (nastasʔilu) /nas.tas.ʔi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
# نَسْتَسْئِلَ (nastasʔila) /nas.tas.ʔi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
# نَسْتَسْئِلْ (nastasʔil) /nas.tas.ʔil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
